title: A simultaneous faithful finite free splitting extension
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, n a natural number and P_i in R[T] (i in Fin n) monic polynomials [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. There is a commutative R-algebra S that is finite [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], free [def-weil-pbc-free-module] and faithful as an R-module, such that every coefficient image P_i in S[T] splits into monic linear factors. The zero ring and n=0 are allowed.

proof.text: For the zero base ring take S=R; every polynomial image is zero and hence splits. For a nonzero base ring, induct on n, taking R itself for n=0. Split the first equation over a nonzero finite free R-algebra T by the existing one-equation splitting lemma, and apply induction over T to the remaining coefficient images.

Compose the algebra structures. Finite modules and free modules are transitive along a scalar tower; map the factorization of the first equation to S, and use the induction factorizations for the others. Since S is nonzero and free over R, uniqueness of basis coefficients makes scalar multiplication faithful.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_faithful_finite_free_splitting (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (P : Fin n → R[X]) (hP : ∀ i, (P i).Monic) :
    ∃ (S : Type u) (_ : CommRing S) (_ : Algebra R S)
      (_ : Module.Finite R S) (_ : Module.Free R S) (_ : FaithfulSMul R S),
      ∀ i, ((P i).map (algebraMap R S)).Splits
